correctness.rationale: The model, boundary conditions and two independent modes are fully specified; stationary averaging gives the exact Laplace transform. Exact second-order expansion gives both moments. A positive integral representation of coth(sqrt(z))/sqrt(z) shows strict logarithmic convexity, and asymptotic endpoint limits show the log derivative ranges over the whole negative half-line, proving both the inverse and sharp attainable moment region. Boundary-matrix checks passed for 15 transform inputs and five reconstructed rate pairs.
